title: Outdoor living area: 65% of required area without permanent roof cover
text: Outdoor Living Area (applies to R2-R25 only). C1.1.1 An outdoor living area to be provided in accordance with Table 1.1a. (Refer to Figure 1.1a) Table 1.1a Outdoor living area provisions. Minimum area without permanent roof cover(1): R2-R15 No minimum applicable; R17.5, R20-R25 65% of the required outdoor living area. 1 Permanent roof cover excludes minor projections (eaves).

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: coding R17.5-R25 (OLA applies to R2-R25 only, Chapter 3 p9). Permanent roof cover excludes eaves (note 1). The fact is the percentage of the REQUIRED OLA that is uncovered. Two-column extract; 65% / 35% appear in both the table and the Figure 1.1a note.
